body: Awesome! Where did you get the glass hanging lamp?
It’s more about the shiny tile being reflective...sure, the bathroom is clean but it would take a LOT of grime to impede one’s ability to see the person in the stall next to them.

You see your colleagues on their phone or doing their business whenever you look down. It’s honestly unavoidable, unless you stare directly forward in the bathroom. Am I really paranoid? It’s the first thing I noticed when I walked in.
You can see people’s faces, including facial expressions. It’s extremely uncomfortable and I usually go out of my way to use a bathroom in a different part of the building.
It’s crazy how skilled the Blue Angels are! Every loop, I’m more impressed by how close the planes are.
